design_issues.screen: Poster Studio & Cover Studio native <select> (poster-template, cover-mode, cover-trim)
issues: Persistent (iterations 57-62) hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — emergent editor injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. Cosmetic only; native page.select_option() cannot match — must use HTMLSelectElement value setter + dispatchEvent('change').
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby — a11y console warning (non-blocking): 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'.

critical_code_review_comments: qics.py:_base_url — good fix (PUBLIC_APP_URL preferred; https-forced fallback). Consider validating that PUBLIC_APP_URL is set at startup and logging a warning if only the http-fallback path can be used — silently emitting an internal cluster URL is exactly what caused the 403 bug in production.

publishing.py:cover_kr_brief — 'series' is hardcoded to 'QRU Foundations'. This means selecting a KR never overrides an existing custom series on the form; the frontend's `data.series || f.series` already handles that gracefully, but consider deriving series from KR pillar/family so cross-series products get correct branding auto-filled.

publishing.py:cover_kr_brief:143 — the concept_notes string embeds the subtitle followed by '.. Symbolic…' (double period from subtitle already ending with period). Cosmetic: strip trailing period on subtitle before interpolation.

poster_studio.py — five new templates + validator extension (panels/callouts/cycle_steps/parts_left/info_boxes accepting string list items) are well-factored. Because BUILDERS/DEFAULTS are keyed by template_id, consider a startup assertion `assert set(TEMPLATES) == set(BUILDERS) == set(DEFAULTS)` to catch mismatches in future additions.
CoverStudio.js:pickKr — successful autofill is a no-op if the KR-brief request fails (only a toast). Consider surfacing which fields were overridden so the founder knows what changed.

rca_of_the_issue: Founder-reported '403 Forbidden when scanning QR' RCA: the QICS companion portal URL was previously derived from FastAPI's request.base_url which — behind the Kubernetes ingress — resolves to the INTERNAL cluster host (understanding-os.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud) over http. Scanning that URL on a phone hit ingress auth/host filters and returned 403. Fix (verified): backend/routers/qics.py:_base_url now prefers PUBLIC_APP_URL env var (set to https://enterprise-os-17.preview.emergentagent.com in /app/backend/.env), and the http→https fallback rewrite still guarantees https on any subsequent host. All 5 legacy portal docs were also migrated to the public URL. Verification path: (a) GET /api/qics/portals lists 5 portals whose portal_url starts with the public host; (b) GET /api/qics/portal/QRU-BK-000004 returns HTTP 200 with a portal JSON body (no auth required, matches phone-scan behavior); (c) POST /api/qics/activate/<new-product-id> produces a portal_url on the public URL and its /portal/{identity} also returns 200. Reproduction of the original bug is no longer possible against the current backend.
